description: Persist a machine-authored, explicitly unreviewed note after investigating a commit. It appears immediately in the repo digest. Optional quoted evidence is raw-object verified.

evidenceFile.description: required literal changed path when side=diff; omit for message

repo.description: absolute path to the git repository; defaults to the server's working directory, and must be inside it (or a root listed in LOGBOOK_MCP_ROOTS); when that directory is part of a repository (it holds files the repository tracks), the tools work on the repository's root

sha.description: the commit being explained (any unique prefix)

side.description: required when span is present: where the exact evidence quote occurs

span.description: optional exact contiguous quote from the commit message or changed blob

why.description: the inferred cause, one sentence, specific (max 400 chars)

name: logbook_annotate
